front: Heal one creature, living or undead, within 30 feet. Daily prep lets you align with life or death for your own healing.
back:
Restore 2 + double your level HP to one creature within 30 feet, living or undead.
Daily preparations: choose life (you're healed by vitality effects as normal) or death (you gain void healing and are healed by void effects and other effects that heal undead).
